# Day Board

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Obsidian Kanban board note for the day.

## Scope note

- Provides a Kanban view with items in columns.
- Includes a drag-and-drop interface to rearrange items within a column, or move between columns.
- Used for workflow processing by status, stage, or category.
